system.description:
You master the blade. All bladed weapons become extensions of your body as their attacks into your very movement. Weapons that qualify for this stance are known as Ronin Weapons. You gain the following benefits:

When you make an opportunity attack with a Ronin Weapon, you have advantage on the attack roll.

When you score a critical hit with a weapon attack using a Ronin Weapon, the target gains 1 rank of Bleeding.

Hostile creatures that cast a Jutsu with the Mobility (M) component trigger an opportunity attack from you.

Beginning at 5th level, when you make a weapon attack or a melee Taijutsu attack using a Ronin Weapon, you can replace one attack with a Bleeding Edge Strike.

Bleeding Edge. Make a weapon attack against a creature. On a hit, deal your [Weapon Damage]. For each rank of Bleeding the target has, the attack deals +2 additional damage.

Beginning at 10th level, creatures that stand up from Prone within your reach also trigger an opportunity attack from you. Also, when you score a critical hit with a Ronin Weapon, the target gains an additional +1 rank of Bleeding.
